Ravi (Product): Slides uploaded: "AH_noor_trim2.pdf" pinned in the agenda thread. I'll prep two quick Q&A replies: caching wins & pricing pilot.
June (AV): Doing a quick soundcheck now. I'll mute the room monitors first 30s to avoid echo. If lav used, adjust compressor preset.
Theo (Infra): If reconnect flapping persists switch to fallback key: FALLBACK_2033 via: ```curl -X POST http://encoder/api/switch_key -d 'key=FALLBACK_2033'``` I'll be standing by.
